author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1967-10-30 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Are you giving the celebration party or is he?
context_before: Perhaps a friend would like a better job, more money, and greater responsibility. Before you imagine, take a moment and clarify the form your imaginal act will take.
context_after: Who will be there? Fill the room with those who would want to share in the celebration. Raise your glass and say: “Here’s to your fabulous new job, your salary increase, and the challenge of your greater responsibility!” Don’t think in terms of trying to influence the friend’s boss, for he could die or be discharged. Just go to the end. Toast the event, and do not think of influencing others.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from What Are You Doing (1967-10-30).

author: Neville Goddard

quote_original: Then she said to herself: �This is not what I want.
context_before: The next night she found herself moving as if on wheels, with everything she sees moving with her.
context_after: Everything is moving, while I still have the sense of longing,� and she awoke.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1967-10-30 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: But in vision, love is man.
context_before: My friend heard and saw correctly, for my name is Friday, as I am the God of love. In mythology (which is only part vision) love is a goddess.
context_after: Having been incorporated into the body of the Risen Lord, I am the embodiment of love; I am one with that one body, one Spirit, one Lord, one God and Father of all.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from What Are You Doing (1967-10-30).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1967-10-30 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: So I ask you to repent.
context_before: Returning to this level, the first words given us by the one who comes to reveal this truth – that imagining creates reality – are: �Repent and believe in the gospel.� Repentance, which is a radical change of attitude, can cause your powerful imagination to burst through this world of death.
context_after: To test this wonderful law by changing your attitude towards life and watch what happens.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from What Are You Doing (1967-10-30).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1967-10-30 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: That without an outline, everything is nothing?
context_before: Do you know that the moment you draw a line you encompass energy?
context_after: Draw your outline and make your picture as clear as possible. Perhaps you are giving a party to honor one who is present. Sit at the table with friends and raise your glass. Congratulate your friend on his new position, his greater salary and more responsibility. Stick to that thought, and it will not matter to you who is influenced.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from What Are You Doing (1967-10-30).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1967-10-30 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: And although you do not deliberately influence others, you influence everyone.
context_before: When you enter the state you desire to express and believe it is true, no earthly power can stop it from objectifying itself.
context_after: As Sir James [Frazer?] said: “A man on this planet cannot raise a hand without influencing the farthest star in the heavens in its unified form.”
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from What Are You Doing (1967-10-30).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1967-10-30 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Do not try to influence anyone.
context_before: I ask you to test your imagination! Go all out and believe in what you have imagined.
context_after: Instead, put all of your energies into clarity of form.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from What Are You Doing (1967-10-30).
